questions.question: If some three consecutive coefficients in the binomial expansion of {\left(x + 1\right)}^{n}$ in powers of $x$ are in the ratio $2 : 15 : 70,$ then the average of these three coefficients is:
questions.explanation:
From the given condition

{}^{n}{C}_{r}{ : }^{n}{C}_{r + 1}{ : }^{n}{C}_{r + 2} = 2 : 15 : 70 \implies \frac{{}^{n}{C}_{r}}{{}^{n}{C}_{r + 1}} = \frac{2}{15}$ and $\frac{{}^{n}{C}_{r + 1}}{{}^{n}{C}_{r + 2}} = \frac{15}{70} \implies \frac{\left(\frac{n!}{\left(n - r\right)! \cdot r!}\right)}{\left(\frac{n!}{\left(n - r - 1\right)! \cdot \left(r + 1\right)!}\right)} = \frac{2}{15}$ and $\frac{\left(\frac{n!}{\left(n - r - 1\right)! \cdot \left(r + 1\right)!}\right)}{\left(\frac{n!}{\left(n - r - 2\right)! \cdot \left(r + 2\right)!}\right)} = \frac{15}{70} \implies \frac{\left(n - r - 1\right)! \cdot \left(r + 1\right)!}{\left(n - r\right)! \cdot r!} = \frac{2}{15}$ and $\frac{\left(n - r - 2\right)! \cdot \left(r + 2\right)!}{\left(n - r - 1\right)! \cdot \left(r + 1\right)!} = \frac{3}{14} \implies \frac{\left(n - r - 1\right)! \cdot \left(r + 1\right) \cdot r!}{\left(n - r\right) \cdot \left(n - r - 1\right)! \cdot r!} = \frac{2}{15}$ and $\frac{\left(n - r - 2\right)! \cdot \left(r + 2\right) \cdot \left(r + 1\right)!}{\left(n - r - 1\right) \cdot \left(n - r - 2\right)! \cdot \left(r + 1\right)!} = \frac{3}{14} \implies \frac{r + 1}{n - r} = \frac{2}{15}$ and $\frac{r + 2}{n - r - 1} = \frac{3}{14} \implies 17r = 2n - 15$ and $17r = 3n - 31 \implies 3n - 31 = 2n - 15, \implies n = 16$ and $r = 1$

Hence, average $= \frac{{}^{n}{C}_{r}{ + }^{n}{C}_{r + 1}{ + }^{n}{C}_{r + 2}}{3} = \frac{{}^{16}{C}_{1}{ + }^{16}{C}_{2}{ + }^{16}{C}_{3}}{3} = 232.$
